title: Hamer language
description: South Omotic language spoken primarily by Hamer people in southwestern Ethiopia
extract: Hamer or Hamer-Banna is a language within the South Omotic branch of the Afroasiatic language family. It is spoken primarily in southern Ethiopia by the Hamar people, Banna people, and by speakers of Karo.
